title: Performance + Auth Update
headline: Lower idle CPU, smoother animations, and a hardened auth gate.
changes: Reduced dashboard idle CPU by 6× — telemetry now batches into one render pass per tick
Server telemetry broadcast interval raised to 2 s — halves frontend render budget
Stripped all hot-path console logs from telemetry, LiveGraph, and disk polling
Fixed auth gate: expired JWT now forces logout instead of silently opening dashboard
Improved entrance animations — removed blur transitions that caused paint-thread jank
Auth timeout and network-error paths now correctly use grace-store fallback
